sharingCriteriaRules.description: Read-only visibility of CP-sourced Opportunities to the CP Manager role and subordinates, for performance attribution. Filters on Source_Channel__c=CP (Picklist) instead of the Lookup Source_CP__c, since Lookup-to-Account fields are rejected by sharing rule criteria.
